reason: Iteration 2 fails critical requirements: no calibration to observed data, no evaluation/validation metrics, no per-agent predictions for days 30–39, and ineffective supply constraints. With one iteration remaining, a focused pass can implement calibration (grid search), evaluation/validation, inventory consumption and tracking, and prediction outputs—bringing the solution to spec compliance.

specific_areas: Implement calibrate() with grid search over bounded parameters to minimize RMSE on days 0–29
Implement evaluate() computing RMSE/MAE/R2_to_observed, enforcement_cost, and inventory_outage_days
Enforce supply consumption (deduct masks when worn) and count outage days
Output per-agent predictions (day, agent_id, is_mask_wearing) for days 30–39
Fix threshold_crossing_time to iterate from start_day and return elapsed days
Separate true simulated series from noisy observed series in aggregation
Align parameter names with spec (theta_mandate, theta_enforce, compliance_decay_rate, beta_household) and enforce bounds
Add validation checks: RMSE threshold, bounds respect, convergence stability, directional validity (mandate/enforcement monotonicity)
Minor cleanup: remove unused imports; document assumptions in code comments

task_understanding.adjustments: Re-emphasize mandatory deliverables: calibration to observed days 0–29, computation of specified metrics, validation criteria checks, supply constraint enforcement, and per-agent predictions for days 30–39.

data_analysis.adjustments: Aggregate train_data.csv by day for observed adoption; ensure day index alignment (0–29). Handle missing days with reindex and NaN-safe metrics.

model_planning.adjustments: Map spec parameters to internal ones (theta_mandate, theta_enforce, compliance_decay_rate, beta_household). Define calibration bounds and grid steps. Plan sensitivity tests for directional validity.

code_generation.adjustments: Add calibrate() grid search and evaluate(); implement mask inventory consumption and enforcement_cost tracking; record per-agent predictions for days 30–39; fix threshold_crossing_time; separate simulated vs observed series.

code_verification.adjustments: Add checks: enforce parameter bounds during calibration; assert RMSE <= threshold; verify adoption non-decreasing when mandate/enforcement increased; unit-test threshold_crossing_time.

simulation_execution.adjustments: Track inventory_outage_days and enforcement_cost during run(); ensure retailer restock and purchase logic uses updated mask inventories; avoid negative stocks.

result_evaluation.adjustments: Compute RMSE/MAE/R2 against observed 0–29; report peak, final adoption, time-to-50%; persist predictions_df for days 30–39.

feedback_generation.adjustments: Summarize calibration outcome (best params, RMSE), report validation checks (pass/fail), and highlight any directional validity or bounds issues clearly.
